criteria.description: S01：Results前四列表头去除首尾空格后须为label、value、unit、source_note，大小写与顺序严格一致；允许后接额外列。表头不符扣3分并触发must_clause_cap，总分上限0.69；缺表或错表名单独归零。
criteria.evidence: required leading header columns match after trimming spaces

criteria.description: S02：每条必需结果单位严格为AUD million nominal；违反扣3分，并触发must_clause_cap（总分上限0.69）。
Deduct for Excel error cells outside result cells already assessed
criteria.evidence: error values outside the graded cells: []

criteria.description: S03：每条必需结果的来源引用非空且不是纯数字；违反扣3分，并触发must_clause_cap（总分上限0.69）。
三条必需结果按题面顺序从第2行排列，不得缺失、重复或逆序。
criteria.evidence: required row sequence: ['2020 network net capex difference', '2020 non-network net capex difference', '2020 total net capex difference']; expected rows 2, 3, 4

criteria.description: S05：Results不得新增标签不在必需列表且带业务值的记录，违反扣3分并触发must_clause_cap。重复必需标签扣3分但不单独触发封顶；无业务值的文字备注和支持工作表不触发此项。
S06：精度p=3；number_format显示p位，或存储值等于其四舍五入至p位的值，均合规；题面至少p位也接受存储小数位数不少于p。数值误差依各派生行容差单独判断。
criteria.evidence: results not showing at least three decimal places: []

criteria.reason: All cell references in candidate source notes (D2-D4) point to real, existing cells in Powercor_RFM_inputs.xlsx sheet 'RFM input'. Verified: L7/L8/L10 contain forecast net capex for Subtransmission/Distribution/SCADA; F61/F62/F64 contain actual capex for same classes; F115/F116/F118 contain disposals; F169/F170/F172 contain contributions. Similarly verified all non-network references (L11-L13, F65-F67, F119-F121, F173-F175) and total references (L7:L14, F61:F68, F115:F122, F169:F176). Asset class names in descriptions match actual row labels. No fabricated files, pages, or tables.
criteria.description: 候选的来源说明虚构了随包材料中不存在的文件、页码或表格。只评来源定位是否真实；数值错算、选错重述口径及已由程序判据计分的额外记录不在此项扣分。未提供来源在程序来源项失分，本项不重复扣分。

criteria.reason: Candidate makes no claims of external audit, real-time queries, or independent verification. Source notes are purely descriptive of input file cell locations and computational methodology ('Actual net capex = capex - disposals - contributions; difference = actual - forecast'). No audit or verification language present anywhere in the workbook.
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。

criteria.reason: Candidate's explanatory text contains only computational methodology descriptions and asset class groupings, all verifiable from the input file. No assertions about company operations, business events, market conditions, or other operating facts beyond what is directly derivable from the input spreadsheet data.
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。

limitations: 原始明细缺少独立evidence、程序reason或运行字段时保留null；已有裁判reasoning逐字保留。
正项score表示正确程度；负项score表示违规程度，sdk_value与raw原样保留。
rubric_sha256为评分资料绑定值，delivery_rubric_sha256为随包文件校验值；评分条目、权重和容差一致。原始回执未记录运行时输入哈希。
未查到唯一完成时间则finished_at保留null；不以文件修改时间代替。
